newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rheinmetall takeover of Hirschmann cleared.
newsitem.headline: Rheinmetall takeover of Hirschmann cleared.

text.p: German defence and engineering group Rheinmetall AG said on Friday that it had received cartel office approval for its takeover of 90 percent of Richard Hirschmann GmbH & Co.

Rheinmetall said in a regulatory news release that approval of the takeover, which took effect from January 1 of this year, would enable the integration of Hirschmann into its automotive, industry and communications technology businesses.

Hirschmann, which has turnover of 530 million marks ($312.8 million) and 2,800 workers, will join Rheinmetall's industrial electronics division, which will employ 4,900 and turn over one billion marks this year.
The remaining 10 percent of Hirschmann will remain in the ownership of the family of the same name.
No price was named for the transaction.
